interpretations.plain_english_summary: The House voted on ordering the previous question for H. Res. 953, a procedural step tied to floor consideration of H.R. 6703, H.R. 498, H.R. 3492, and H.R. 4776.
interpretations.what_happened: The House voted on whether to order the previous question for H. Res. 953.
interpretations.why_it_mattered: The vote affected whether the House moved forward procedurally toward adopting the rule for considering the listed measures.
interpretations.member_vote_context: This candidate explains the procedural vote only. It does not map a member's Yea or Nay to support or opposition on the underlying bills.
interpretations.what_not_to_infer: Do not treat this as final passage of H.R. 6703, H.R. 498, H.R. 3492, or H.R. 4776, or as a direct policy position on every measure included in the rule.
interpretations.uncertainty_note: Procedural-context row. It explains House floor process and remains excluded from support/opposition and alignment math.
interpretations.interpretation_reason: Candidate uses the official roll-call question and Congress.gov rule-resolution context. It is not a substantive issue-position interpretation.
